title: Ebola in East Africa
summary: A Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with no approved vaccine or treatment, has passed 9,400 cases and reached an eighth province. Kenya has eight cases, all linked to one imported patient, with no community spread so far.

background.text: Outbreak detected in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
Kenya's first patient, who travelled from Congo, dies in Nairobi.
